tagline: Shared vector memory for remote teammates — storing facts needs your approval.
requirements: Set QDRANT_URL in the host environment, plus QDRANT_API_KEY for hosted or protected instances. Set COLLECTION_NAME to pin a shared collection; otherwise the guest must name the collection in every call. This is the official server from Qdrant.

tools.name: qdrant-find
tools.note: Semantic search over the configured collection.

tools.name: qdrant-store
tools.note: Adds information to the shared collection.

seo.description: Share the official Qdrant MCP server with MCPWire. Point the host at a collection, let teammates search shared context over P2P, and keep writes behind approval.
